resources.string: Cannot start the camera service (%1$s). Open the app and try again.
Face not visible enough during calibration. Place the phone in front of you at eye level, 40–70 cm away.
Eyes looked closed during calibration. Look straight ahead with eyes open and try again.
Calibrating — look straight ahead, eyes open
Counted as closed when EAR < %1$s (baseline %2$s × 0.7) or blink score > 0.5

1. Eyes closed: a frame counts as closed when EAR (eye openness) drops below 70%% of your own normal value (measured during calibration) or MediaPipe blink score is above 0.5. Frames with head turned more than 35° are ignored.
2. DANGER at once: eyes closed continuously for 1.2 s or more. A normal blink lasts only 0.1–0.4 s, so it never triggers.
3. Tired (PERCLOS): share of time the eyes were closed in the last 60 s. 15%% or more = WARNING, 25%% or more = DANGER (needs at least 30 s of data).
4. Yawn: mouth wide open (jawOpen above 0.6) for 2 s or more. 3 yawns in 5 minutes = WARNING.
5. Head nod: head tilts more than 15° from calibration and comes back within 1.5 s. 2 nods in 1 minute = WARNING. Head held down with eyes closed for 0.5 s = DANGER.
6. The level only goes down after the signs have been gone for 5 s. No face for more than 3 s only shows a notice, no alarm.
Also raise the phone alarm volume. Alerts use the alarm stream, so silent or media volume does not affect them.
